events.title: DeckTerra Demo Update - 1.0.3
events.summary: A brand new update is here for the DeckTerra Demo! Here's what's new: Expanded Tech TreeThis update adds 12 new Technologies to unlock, which unlocks a total of 8 buildings, 5 units, and a number of additional passive buffs and city construction actions. These new technologies serve two purposes:To add additional buildings and unlocks to the mid/late game of the demo (turns 30-50)To make a scientific victory more difficult to achieve. events.summary: Thank you for playing the demo :) Here's what's changed in update 1.0.1: Performance Improvements Sweeping performance improvements across the board.
